newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-ANDERSEN CONSULTING WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP SCHEDULED.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-ANDERSEN CONSULTING WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP SCHEDULED.

text.p: Schedule for the 1997 Andersen Consulting World Championship of golf, whose 1996 title was won by Australian Greg Norman over American Scott Hoch on Sunday:
Japan section - Golden Palm Country Club, Kagoshima, Japan (March 1-2)
U.S. section - Reynolds Plantation, Lake Oconee, Georgia (April 21-22)
European section - Buckinghamshire Golf Club, Denham, England (May 19-20)
International section - Blackwolf Run, Kohler, Wisconsin (July 28-29)
World finals - Grayhawk Golf Club, Scottsdale, Arizona (January 3-4)
